# maple_ingest_keys (Data Source)

The organization's ingest keys, for wiring OpenTelemetry exporters without copying keys by hand. Reading them needs an org-admin API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "maple_ingest_keys" "this" {}

# Hand the private key to a service's OpenTelemetry exporter.
resource "kubernetes_secret" "otel" {
  metadata { name = "maple-ingest" }
  data = { MAPLE_INGEST_KEY = data.maple_ingest_keys.this.private_key }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The private ingest key (`maple_sk_…`) for servers.
- `private_rotated_at` (String) When the private key was last rolled.
- `public_key` (String, Sensitive) The public ingest key (`maple_pk_…`), safe for browsers and mobile apps.
- `public_rotated_at` (String) When the public key was last rolled.
